user.title: Działdowo Waste Pickup AI
user.description: Configure the waste schedule scanner for annual pickup tables used by Gmina Działdowo, Poland.

data_description.notify_targets: Select one or more notify services. Leave empty to use Home Assistant persistent notifications.
data_description.morning_time: HH:MM, local Home Assistant time. Notification fires the day before pickup.
data_description.evening_time: HH:MM, local Home Assistant time. Notification fires the day before pickup.
data_description.notification_channel: Channel name in the HA Companion app on Android. After the first notification you can find it under Settings → Apps → Home Assistant → Notifications and set a custom sound, vibration, and Do Not Disturb bypass there.
data_description.notification_sticky: Notification cannot be swiped away (Android). Must be dismissed manually.
data_description.notification_sound_ios: Sound filename bundled with the HA Companion app on iOS, e.g. default, RisingChime.caf, SyntheticChime.caf, or US-EN-Alexa-Trash-Pickup.caf. Full list: https://companion.home-assistant.io/docs/notifications/notification-sounds/
data_description.notification_critical: iOS: bypasses silent mode and Do Not Disturb. Requires Critical Alerts to be enabled in the HA Companion app (Settings → Companion App → Notifications → Critical Alerts).
